scope: Screen a newly found AC1032 sample that declares ACDBASSOCNETWORK classes and add a reusable read-only inventory selector for eligible physical inputs.

source.sampleHistory: The file entered the ACadSharp repository in commit cd170b23080deec3ab7b2578cdbef5e37532ba40, which moved it into samples/aec_objects and added AEC wall tests. Its DWG producer and integrity provenance are not established.
source.fixturePolicy: Read in place from the adjacent ACadSharp checkout; not copied or modified.

reader.result: FAIL before OBJECTS callbacks: format 18 error 7 (BAD_READ_HANDLES); no typed network records were published.
reader.otherIntegrityObservation: The AC1024+ header envelope reports expected 901 bytes and observed 905 bytes at logical offset 16. This candidate therefore has multiple integrity discrepancies before associative-object decoding.

inventorySelectorOnCandidate.result: FAIL as expected: import stops at BAD_READ_HANDLES before object callbacks, so no ACDBASSOCNETWORK rows are available to the inventory selector.

existingInventorySelectorSanity.result: PASS; reports the two already-qualified candidate records from the LibreDWG sample, including bounded field spans, separate action indexes and handle roles.

implementation.change: Add --assocnetwork-source-inventory to print all imported ACDBASSOCNETWORK handles, owner/action candidates, prefix spans and reader status for a caller-supplied DWG. It makes no output or support decision and adds no fixture.

decision: This is not an associative-network field witness: the class count is only CLASSES metadata, the reader never reached OBJECTS, the declared handle-map tail is unexplained, and producer provenance is unknown. Do not weaken handle-map or HEADER integrity checks, do not infer network fields from the class count, and retain the AC1032 writer refusal. Resume only with a structurally eligible AC1032 source whose OBJECTS frames can be decoded, plus independent source/native evidence for the exact class-version-2 profile.
